title: Lake Mead Marina
specs: Lake Mead has 550 miles of shoreline with varied terrain and is ideal for water sports
Boat lessee and all drivers must be at least 21 years of age
All drivers required to have Boating Safety Education Card or Boating License regardless of age or experience
US and Canadian residents require valid driver's license; international residents require driver's license
Minors 17 or younger must have parent or legal guardian complete rental contract and waiver
Enough agility to lower yourself into kayak and hoist yourself out of water
Sport boat seats up to 8 people, max 1850 lbs including persons and gear
Pontoon boats seat 6 to 10 people depending on model

blurb: Guests rent various boats including sport boats and pontoons, as well as kayaks and standup paddleboards to enjoy water activities on Lake Mead. Rentals include safety equipment and require a boating safety education card for drivers. The marina offers a streamlined reservation and check-in process via a mobile app.
extraNote: Reservations made for full day only; walk-ins and half days first come first serve · Deposit required at time of booking; rental rate required at pick-up · No cancellation within 72 hours of scheduled reservation · No shows charged deposit price · Fuel not included for sport boats; lessee pays for fuel used after full tank · Hemenway Harbor at Lake Mead
